name: Anansi
description: ANANSI is the token of Anansi Data, a pay-per-call data API on Base that sells machine-readable datasets to AI agents over the x402 protocol. Revenue from data sales is routed on-chain to automatic buybacks and burns. Supply is burn-only: the contract has no mint function, so total supply can only fall, down to a hard floor of 21,000,000. Liquidity is held in a non-withdrawable escrow, and every contract is source-verified on BaseScan with no owner and no privileged role.
